decision.title: Who the subgraph calls the API as
decision.question: Every request carries one service bearer token, so any client the supergraph lets through can read any customer's orders, IBANs (D-a39c6a) and integration webhook URLs, and can create, update and cancel orders. Forward the caller's own token so the API enforces per-user access, or keep the service token and have the router require authentication on those fields? (@authenticated/@requiresScopes are licensed router features this target leaves out of the workspace schema: federation-subgraph.md; they would be a change in your own graph.)

choices.label: Forward the caller's Authorization header as AUTH_EXPR at export
Keep the service token; require router authentication on order, customer and integration fields and the three mutations, in your own graph
Keep the service token as is; access is controlled before the supergraph
